nathan_fillion_witness_point_film_lionsg.headline: Witness Point

hunchback_movie_tells_the_dark_story_the.headline: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris

spiderverse3_update_2026.headline: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
spiderverse3_update_2026.summary: The concluding animated film of the Spider-Verse trilogy is set for a theatrical release on June 18, 2027.

Filmmakers Phil Lord, Chris Miller, Bob Persichetti, and Justin K. Thompson confirmed the June 18, 2027 release
The film concludes the Oscar‑winning Spider‑Verse trilogy starring Miles Morales
spiderverse3_update_2026.why_it_matters: It promises to wrap up a critically acclaimed animated franchise that has reshaped superhero cinema.

colin_farrell_s_panned_cyberpunk_remake_.headline: AKIRA
colin_farrell_s_panned_cyberpunk_remake_.summary: Crunchyroll is re-releasing the 1988 anime film AKIRA in 4K and IMAX in the United States and Canada.

netflix_s_most_romantic_christmas_is_alr.headline: Blue Box Season 2
netflix_s_most_romantic_christmas_is_alr.summary: Episode 5 of Blue Box Season 2 aired on Netflix, delivering a Christmas‑themed romantic moment between Chinatsu and Taiki.

The episode features a Christmas‑day basketball match that brings Yumeka, Chinatsu and Taiki together.

The episode is part of the ongoing second season streaming on Netflix.

my_hero_ultra_rumble_game_gets_mobile_ve.headline: My Hero Ultra Rumble Mobile Version
my_hero_ultra_rumble_game_gets_mobile_ve.summary: Bandai Namco announced a mobile version of the My Hero Ultra Rumble battle‑royale game with a teaser trailer and pre‑registration now open.

Pre‑registration is live for iOS and Android devices
The mobile version will support cross‑play between iOS and Android but not with console/PC versions
my_hero_ultra_rumble_game_gets_mobile_ve.why_it_matters: Bringing the popular battle‑royale game to smartphones expands the franchise’s reach and introduces cross‑play for mobile gamers.

golden_kamuy_liveaction_cast_jan2027.headline: Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc (live-action series)
golden_kamuy_liveaction_cast_jan2027.summary: The live‑action Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc series announced two new cast members and a key visual ahead of its January 2027 debut.

Hiroto Ōshita cast as Kirawus
Kenji Katagiri returns as director alongside Masaaki Yoshimura
Series will stream on WOWOW starting January 24, 2027
golden_kamuy_liveaction_cast_jan2027.why_it_matters: The addition of new characters expands the adaptation’s storyline and keeps momentum after the successful 2026 film.

late_tetsuya_chiba_s_autobiographical_ma.headline: Hinemosu Notari Nikki
late_tetsuya_chiba_s_autobiographical_ma.summary: Tetsuya Chiba's autobiographical manga Hinemosu Notari Nikki will conclude with its eighth volume.
highlights: The series began in Big Comic in December 2015 and has released seven compiled volumes, the latest in November 2025.
Chiba placed the manga on hiatus in September 2026 due to poor health and passed away on October 22, 2026.
Shogakukan is publishing the final eighth volume, bringing the autobiographical work to a close.
The manga’s conclusion marks the end of Chiba’s final personal project after a 70‑year career.
late_tetsuya_chiba_s_autobiographical_ma.why_it_matters: The final volume provides closure to Chiba’s last autobiographical narrative and honors his legacy in manga history.

hirayasumi_tv_anime_stream_netflix_major.headline: Hirayasumi TV Anime
hirayasumi_tv_anime_stream_netflix_major.summary: The TV anime adaptation of Keigo Shinzō's Hirayasumi manga will stream internationally on Netflix starting January 2027.
highlights: Viz Media announced the anime will stream worldwide on Netflix in January 2027

hirayasumi_tv_anime_stream_netflix_major.why_it_matters: The Netflix release gives the slice‑of‑life series a global platform, expanding its audience beyond Japan.

alan_ritchson_dcu_role.headline: Alan Ritchson
alan_ritchson_dcu_role.summary: Alan Ritchson, who previously portrayed Aquaman on Smallville and Hawk on Titans, is rumored to be in talks with James Gunn for a new role in the DC Universe franchise.

alan_ritchson_dcu_role.why_it_matters: A new DCU casting could add a proven superhero actor to upcoming films or series, influencing future storylines.

dc_villains_who_can_give_the_flash_a_run.headline: 7 DC Villains Who Can Give the Flash a Run for His Money
dc_villains_who_can_give_the_flash_a_run.summary: ComicBook.com lists seven speed‑ster villains from DC Comics who challenge the Flash’s mastery of the Speed Force.
highlights: The article profiles Reverse‑Flash (Danny West), Savitar, Red Death, Godspeed, Zoom, Black Flash and Professor Zoom
Each villain’s origin ties to the Speed Force, with unique abilities like energy absorption, force‑field generation, and time‑travel
The piece references New 52, Dark Multiverse, and various Flash family members as foils
dc_villains_who_can_give_the_flash_a_run.why_it_matters: Understanding these foes deepens readers’ appreciation of the Flash’s mythos and upcoming storylines.

heisei_haizan_hei_sumire_chan_manga_resu.headline: Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan
heisei_haizan_hei_sumire_chan_manga_resu.summary: Satomi U's Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan manga will resume serialization in Weekly Young Magazine's 51st issue on November 16.

heisei_haizan_hei_sumire_chan_manga_resu.why_it_matters: The return marks the continuation of a critically recognized series and signals the author's return to work after maternity leave.

dc_studios_head_change_2026_11_09.headline: James Gunn & Peter Safran Stepping Down As DC Studios Heads, Jeremy Latcham Named Successor
dc_studios_head_change_2026_11_09.summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran will leave their co‑leadership of DC Studios on Dec 1, with former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham taking over.

dc_leadership_change_2026.headline: Darkman
dc_leadership_change_2026.summary: Sam Raimi says talks continue for a Darkman reboot or legacy sequel, but funding remains the biggest hurdle.

Batman’s DCU debut was set for The Brave and the Bold
Superman sequels were planned for 2029 and 2031 to culminate in a Justice League

vegito_is_dragon_ball_s_strongest_fusion.headline: Dragon Ball Fusions (3DS)

Developed by Ganbarion in Fukuoka, Japan
vegito_is_dragon_ball_s_strongest_fusion.why_it_matters: It expands the Dragon Ball franchise onto handheld consoles with a unique fusion mechanic for fans.

shonen_jump_gets_ready_end_more_manga_ne.headline: Weekly Shonen Jump New Manga Launches April 2026

dc_fans_stunned_james_gunn_leaving_studi.headline: James Gunn and Peter Safran Depart DC Studios
dc_fans_stunned_james_gunn_leaving_studi.summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran will step down as co‑presidents of DC Studios effective December, with former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham taking over.

dc_fans_stunned_james_gunn_leaving_studi.why_it_matters: The leadership overhaul could reshape the direction of the DC Universe and affect upcoming film and TV releases.

dc_leader_latcham_dec2026.headline: GAMERA -Rebirth

izumi_miyazono_s_kekkon_shimash_koi_suru.headline: Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni

netflix_jan2027_anime_trailer.headline: Blend S

ghost_yoru_no_hate_unveils_additional_st.headline: Ghost – End of Night (Ghost: Yoru no Hate)

fan_favorite_anime_confirms_return_after.headline: The Dangers in My Heart Season 3

web_manga_ore_no_shibou_flag_ga_todomaru.headline: Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai

spyxfamily_s4_2027.headline: Record of Ragnarok Season 3 Anime

dc_studios_gunn_safran_exit_2026.headline: The A-Team (2010) Becomes a Streaming Hit on Paramount+

the_beat_digest_bloodrayne_major_release.headline: BloodRayne Comics Series Kickstarter

kodansha_s_comic_tint_digital_magazine_e.headline: Kodansha's Comic Tint Digital Magazine to End After 9 Years

my_death_flags_anime_adapt_2027.headline: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending

antarctic_press_january_solicits_tomorro.headline: Tomorrow Girl X Zen The Intergalactic Ninja #2

code_geass_2027_new_anime.headline: Suikoden: The Anime

harley_queen_2027_creative_team.headline: Harley Quinn #71 – New Creative Team Revealed

hidive_made_abyss_awakening_mystery_film.headline: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery

dragon_quest_rpg_mobile_game_s_reveals_l.headline: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle

star_wars_marvel_crossover_midnight_rele.summary: The first issue of the Star Wars/Marvel crossover will debut as a midnight release in comic stores on January 13, 2027.

Written by Kevin Smith and illustrated by David Marquez
Final order cut‑off for retailers is November 23, 2026
Features first on‑page meeting of Marvel heroes with Star Wars characters such as Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader
star_wars_marvel_crossover_midnight_rele.why_it_matters: The event marks the first official crossover between Marvel and Star Wars, celebrating Star Wars’ 50th anniversary and driving foot traffic to local comic retailers.

abs_batman_anim_adapt_2026.headline: Absolute Batman (animated series)
highlights: The series is deep into development with early visual material shown at NYCC
It will be a 2D animation aiming to stay faithful while expanding Bruce Wayne’s world
Creator Scott Snyder says the show will build on the comic’s first arc and serve as a ‘novelization’ of the series
abs_batman_anim_adapt_2026.why_it_matters: Absolute Batman is a high‑profile DC Comics title, and its adaptation signals Skydance’s commitment to leveraging flagship IPs under the new DC Studios structure.

dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.headline: Uncle Zaxlor Sampler
dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.summary: The Uncle Zaxlor Sampler comic is debuting free at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition in Harrogate.
highlights: Uncle Zaxlor Sampler by Leo Healy and Torgo Wells will be available free at Redshirt Hall table D20 at Thought Bubble
The sampler offers an all‑ages preview of the sci‑fi comedy world of Uncle Zaxlor’s Robot Repair Shop
Issues 1 and 2 of the series will also be on sale at the convention
dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.why_it_matters: It gives fans a hands‑on look at a new small‑press sci‑fi comedy series and supports the creator‑focused spirit of Thought Bubble’s milestone event.

wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.headline: Gatto
wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.summary: Pixar’s upcoming film Gatto features a cat protagonist and a new 2‑D hand‑painted visual style blended with CG.
highlights: Mark Ruffalo voices Nero, a black stray cat in Venice
The film combines 2‑D hand‑painted animation with CG depth
A star‑studded cast includes Laurence Fishburne, John Turturro and Isabella Rossellini
An original short titled “Loving Dory” will accompany the feature
wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.why_it_matters: The stylistic shift shows Pixar experimenting beyond its traditional polished CG look, potentially influencing future animation trends.

times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.headline: DC Movie Franchises That Ended Despite Sequel Plans
times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.summary: Several DC film series have been abruptly halted despite having sequels in development, highlighting the franchise’s volatility.
highlights: The Flash (2023) earned $271.4 million on a $220 million budget and its planned sequel was cancelled after poor reception.
Black Adam (2022) grossed $393.5 million against a $260 million budget, leading to the cancellation of Black Adam 2 and related crossovers.
Superman IV (1987) made $36.7 million on a $17 million budget, prompting the abandonment of the planned Superman Reborn sequel.
Batman Returns (1992) performed poorly enough that Tim Burton’s intended third Batman film was shelved, shifting the franchise to Joel Schumacher.
times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.why_it_matters: Understanding these cancellations reveals the challenges DC faces in maintaining a cohesive cinematic universe.

azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.headline: Azmodanus Demonic Debut Spinoff
azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.summary: A new Azmodanus comic by Dark Cloud creators Dan Chadwick and Anthony Cook launches at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition.
highlights: The spinoff centers on the devil Azmodanus, first introduced in Dark Cloud #3.
It presents a forced‑therapy story that reveals the secret history of Hell’s Damnation Accords.
The debut occurs at Thought Bubble’s 20th‑anniversary event in Harrogate on November 14‑15.
Creators Dan Chadwick and Anthony Cook are the writers/artists behind the project.
azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.why_it_matters: It expands the Dark Cloud universe and highlights small‑press creators at a major UK comic festival.

bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.headline: Bonaparte
bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.summary: Luca le Jeune’s adult‑only manga Bonaparte, depicting Napoleon’s return and the lead‑up to Waterloo, debuts at Thought Bubble 2026.
highlights: Debuts at Thought Bubble’s 20th anniversary weekend in Harrogate on 14 November 2026
Published under the Loocart banner and available at Redshirt Hall, table B6b
Inspired by Sergei Bondarchuk’s 1970 epic film Waterloo
Targets adult readers with a historical war narrative
bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.why_it_matters: Shows the growing prominence of small‑press, creator‑owned manga in Western comic festivals.

keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.headline: Yield
keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.summary: Nicola Streeten’s new graphic novel Yield launches at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition in Harrogate.
highlights: Yield is a full‑colour hardback of 228 pages published by Plowman Press
The story follows John Evarts of Black Mountain College, blending queer history, family memory and archival research
Streeten will present the book at the UK’s largest comic art festival, Thought Bubble, on 14‑15 November 2026
keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.why_it_matters: The debut spotlights a small‑press work that explores under‑represented queer histories within the comics medium.

dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.headline: Amazing Spider-Man: Power And Responsibility
dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.summary: Marvel announced the first Marvel Brick collection, gathering the early Amazing Spider-Man stories into a 960‑page paperback.
highlights: Collects Amazing Fantasy #15 and Amazing Spider-Man #1‑38 plus the first two annuals
Features first appearances of Spider-Man, Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus and many other classic characters
Will be released July 6, 2027 as a $60 paperback, cheaper than the Epic Collection line
Designed by Tom Muller with a distinctive trade‑dress and “lit‑up” volume indicator
dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.why_it_matters: The Brick format offers an affordable way to own the foundational Spider‑Man run that’s often out of print.

avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.headline: ComicsPRO names Moni Barrette as new Executive Director
avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.summary: ComicsPRO has appointed Moni Barrette, a veteran librarian and nonprofit leader, as its new Executive Director.
highlights: Barrette brings 20 years of library experience and several years at LibraryPass (now Joyful Reading)
She founded Creators Assemble, a networking nonprofit for comic creators
Barrette replaces outgoing director Marco Davanzo, who stepped down at SDCC
The search emphasized hiring a non‑retailer to focus on industry‑wide relationship building
avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.why_it_matters: Her extensive industry network and nonprofit expertise aim to strengthen ComicsPRO’s support for comic retailers nationwide.

lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.headline: Furious Redbrow
lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.summary: Dark Horse Comics announced Furious Redbrow, a three‑issue fantasy series by Ben Stenbeck set in the Lands Unknown universe.
highlights: The series follows Redbrow, son of Whitedog, who will become known as the God‑Killer.
It builds on Stenbeck’s 2026 series The Skinless Man and features colors and lettering by Dave Stewart and Clem Robins.
Main cover art by Stenbeck with variant covers by Mike Mignola, Andrea Borgioni and Ben McEntee.
Furious Redbrow #1 is slated for release on March 17, 2027.
lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.why_it_matters: It expands Mike Mignola’s Lands Unknown universe, offering fans deeper lore and new characters.

marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.headline: Doctor Doom’s Traumatic Backstory Revealed in Avengers: Doomsday
marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.summary: Marvel confirmed that Doctor Doom has lost a child, adding depth to his motivations in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday film.
highlights: Empire Magazine confirms Doom is a father who suffered the loss of a child
The VisionQuest post‑credits scene shows Doom confronting Wanda Maximoff to claim her powers
Trailers for Avengers: Doomsday have already hinted at Doom’s vendetta against the Avengers
marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.why_it_matters: The revelation ties Doom’s personal trauma to his antagonistic agenda, enriching the narrative stakes for the film.

j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.headline: J-Novel Club Licenses Seven Light Novels and Six Manga Series
j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.summary: J‑Novel Club announced the addition of seven new light novel series and six manga series to its digital lineup, with two titles slated for print in 2027.
highlights: Seven new light novel licenses were revealed, with eBook releases scheduled throughout February 2027
Six new manga titles are now available digitally, with two slated for print in early 2027
Print releases include Nahuse's Rebuild World (April 27, 2027) and A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex‑Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince! (June 8, 2027)
j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.why_it_matters: The acquisitions expand J‑Novel Club's catalog, offering English‑speaking fans more diverse titles across light novels and manga.

The voice cast features newcomers such as Nozomi Nirei and Kokona Nonaka
The series is part of the Link! Like! Love Live! project tied to a 2023 smartphone app

aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.headline: Aquaman
aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.summary: Kakao Entertainment's romance webtoon Aquaman is being adapted into a 10‑episode Japanese live‑action series premiering on December 25, 2026.
highlights: The series is a joint project between Kakao Entertainment and Fuji TV, with production by AOI Pro.
It will debut simultaneously in Japan on Fuji TV’s streaming service and in South Korea on Wavve.

aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.why_it_matters: It marks a high‑profile Japanese live‑action adaptation of a popular Korean webtoon, expanding its audience across East Asia.

avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.headline: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5
avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.summary: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5 has been officially announced with an ultra‑teaser visual released.

An ultra‑teaser visual for Season 5 has been unveiled.
Season 5 will continue the story into the seventh arc, described as even more brutal than the previous arc.
avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.why_it_matters: The announcement confirms the continuation of a flagship series beyond its 10th anniversary, keeping fans engaged with new story developments.

gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.headline: Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2
gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.summary: Season 2 of Gushing Over Magical Girls unveiled a new visual, trailer and a 2027 release date, with Asahi Production returning as studio.
highlights: New visual and trailer confirm a 2027 release date
Asahi Production will animate the sequel, same studio as season 1
All main cast members will reprise their roles
gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.why_it_matters: The continuation expands a popular magical‑girl franchise that has a growing international manga readership.

movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.headline: Superman ’78
movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.summary: DC Comics released a sequel miniseries to the 1978 Superman film, continuing its story with Brainiac and Metallo.
highlights: The miniseries follows the film’s continuity, featuring Brainiac shrinking Metropolis and capturing Kryptonian citizens including Jor-El
A follow‑up story, The Metal Curtain, pits Superman against a Soviet‑styled Metallo with a Kryptonite‑powered suit
The comics aim to capture the light‑hearted tone of the original movie, free from its special‑effects limitations
movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.why_it_matters: It expands the beloved 1978 film universe for fans seeking new adventures in its classic style.

father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.headline: The Father, The Son, and The Holy Ghost Mine
father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.summary: Tyler Crook and Emily Schnall are launching a three‑issue horror‑western prestige series with Oni Press in February 2027.
highlights: The series follows runaway brothers Buck and Toby as they investigate a Nevada silver mine haunted by ancient horrors.
Each 40‑page issue includes cardstock covers and extensive backmatter such as process art and historical references.
The debut issue releases on February 3, 2027, priced at $6.99 and featuring multiple variant covers.
Creator duo previously collaborated on Tales from Harrow County, bringing their horror expertise to the Old West setting.
father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.why_it_matters: It blends classic Western mythos with horror, expanding the genre scope of modern indie comics.

rezero_s5_ann.headline: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu
rezero_s5_ann.summary: A fifth season of the Re:Zero anime was announced at the series' 10th Anniversary Starlight Party event.
highlights: The 10th Anniversary Starlight Party special revealed an ultra‑teaser visual for season 5.
The series is produced by White Fox, which handled all previous seasons.
Crunchyroll streamed the fourth season and will likely continue streaming the new season.
The announcement follows the recent airing of season 4’s Soshitsu‑hen and Dakkan‑hen arcs.
rezero_s5_ann.why_it_matters: The continuation extends one of the most popular isekai franchises, keeping its large fanbase engaged.

dc_studios_gunn_exit_2026.headline: Angela (Marvel) Ongoing Series
dc_studios_gunn_exit_2026.summary: Marvel announced a new Angela ongoing series debuting February 10, 2027.
highlights: Written by Wes Craig in his Marvel writing debut
Artwork by Pere Pérez
First issue features a main cover by Kaare Andrews and a variant by Wes Craig
Series follows Angela hunting a demon outbreak in New York City
dc_studios_gunn_exit_2026.why_it_matters: The launch revives a fan‑favorite character and expands Marvel’s celestial roster amid renewed interest from the Marvel Rivals game.

adam_driver_s_harsh_response_disney_afte.headline: The Hunt for Ben Solo (scrapped Star Wars film)
adam_driver_s_harsh_response_disney_afte.summary: Adam Driver called Disney’s decision to cancel the Steven Soderbergh‑penned Star Wars film ‘The Hunt for Ben Solo’ criminal.
highlights: Driver said he spent over two years collaborating with Soderbergh on the script
Disney and Lucasfilm officially rejected the nearly finished script in 2025
Driver expressed disappointment while promoting his new film Paper Tiger
adam_driver_s_harsh_response_disney_afte.why_it_matters: The cancellation ends what could have been the first Star Wars film focused on Kylo Ren’s redemption, impacting the franchise’s future direction.

charlie_adlard_swaps_walking_dead_talkin.headline: The Mountains Belong To Us
charlie_adlard_swaps_walking_dead_talkin.summary: Charlie Adlard and Benjamin Dickson preview their upcoming 2027 comic series The Mountains Belong To Us at Thought Bubble.
highlights: Adlard, known for The Walking Dead, teams with writer Benjamin Dickson on the new series
Sampler copies were given away at the 20th Thought Bubble convention in Harrogate
The story follows a young woman who inherits a talking flock of sheep during wartime
charlie_adlard_swaps_walking_dead_talkin.why_it_matters: The collaboration pairs two acclaimed creators, promising a fresh narrative in the indie comics market.

lilo_stitch_drops_new_animated_revival_a.headline: Lilo & Scratch Animated Short
lilo_stitch_drops_new_animated_revival_a.summary: Walt Disney Animation Studios released first‑look images for the new Lilo & Scratch short that will debut in theaters ahead of the upcoming film Hexed.
highlights: The short is the first new Disney animated short in five years and combines 2D designs with the studio’s current CG pipeline.
It will screen with Hexed starting on November 25, 2026.
Directed by Malcon Pierce and Fawn Veerasunthorn, it features Maia Kealoha as Lilo and Chris Sanders reprising Stitch’s voice.
lilo_stitch_drops_new_animated_revival_a.why_it_matters: The short revives the classic look of the original Lilo & Stitch while building excitement for the live‑action sequel slated for 2028.

avatar_seven_havens_s2_2026.headline: Jan Is in Danger!
avatar_seven_havens_s2_2026.summary: Ryo Nakama returns to Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump with a new gag manga titled Jan Is in Danger!
highlights: The series is set to debut in the upcoming issue of Weekly Shonen Jump this weekend
It marks Nakama’s first new manga in three years since High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ended in 2023
The first‑look teaser shows a happy‑go‑lucky teen unaware of an explosion behind him, hinting at a parody style
Shonen Jump is using the slot left by the concluding series Witch Watch to introduce the new title
avatar_seven_havens_s2_2026.why_it_matters: Nakama’s comeback adds fresh content to Shonen Jump’s lineup as several long‑running series wrap up

dc_leadership_change_2026_11.headline: Matilda
dc_leadership_change_2026_11.summary: Danny DeVito’s 1996 fantasy comedy ‘Matilda’ has become the No. 2 most‑watched movie worldwide on HBO Max, highlighting its enduring popularity three decades after release.
highlights: Matilda is currently the No. 2 most‑watched movie worldwide on HBO Max according to FlixPatrol
The film holds a Certified Fresh 90% score on Rotten Tomatoes and a 7.0 rating on IMDb
Directed, produced, and starring Danny DeVito, the movie remains a beloved adaptation of Roald Dahl’s novel
dc_leadership_change_2026_11.why_it_matters: The streaming surge demonstrates the lasting appeal of classic family films in the modern on‑demand era.

uzono_shiniko_h_koku_manga_ends_4th_volu.headline: Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku
uzono_shiniko_h_koku_manga_ends_4th_volu.summary: Kadokawa announced the fourth volume of Gonbe Shinkawa's Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku manga as the series' final installment.
highlights: The fourth volume is slated to ship on January 7.
The series began on Kadokawa's ComicWalker website in December 2024.
It adapts Bunkichi Majima's novel and features storyboard composition by Asahiro Kakashi.
uzono_shiniko_h_koku_manga_ends_4th_volu.why_it_matters: The conclusion wraps up a unique supernatural investigation narrative that has attracted a niche readership.

major_shonen_jump_series_officially_ends.headline: Witch Watch
major_shonen_jump_series_officially_ends.summary: Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch manga concluded with Chapter 270, ending its five‑year run in Weekly Shonen Jump.
highlights: Final chapter 270 was released, wrapping up the series after five years since its debut
The chapter features a seven‑year time skip showing Morihito and Nico married with a newborn child
The series ends as part of a wave of major Shonen Jump titles concluding in 2026
major_shonen_jump_series_officially_ends.why_it_matters: The conclusion marks the end of one of the few long‑running comedy‑action series still active from the late‑2010s era.

metal_sonic_s_unleashed_new_sonic_anime_.headline: Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond
metal_sonic_s_unleashed_new_sonic_anime_.summary: SEGA released the anime‑style short "Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond" to celebrate the franchise’s 35th anniversary.
highlights: The short was directed by Kevin Molina‑Ortiz for GXS Productions in collaboration with SEGA.
Script was written by Ian Flynn and features the original English voice cast returning for their roles.
A Japanese language version with a separate voice cast was also released.
The short introduces a high‑octane battle with Metal Sonic, previewing his role in the upcoming live‑action film Sonic the Hedgehog 4.
metal_sonic_s_unleashed_new_sonic_anime_.why_it_matters: It demonstrates SEGA’s continued investment in anime adaptations and builds hype for Sonic the Hedgehog 4’s inclusion of Metal Sonic.

demon_slayer_gets_a_major_future_update_.headline: Demon Slayer Franchise Long-Term Plans
demon_slayer_gets_a_major_future_update_.summary: Aniplex and Sony Entertainment disclosed ambitions to keep Demon Slayer active for up to a century, despite the series’ limited source material.
highlights: Aniplex president Atsuhiro Iwakami said the goal is to sustain Demon Slayer for 10‑100 years, citing Dragon Ball and One Piece as models
The first Infinity Castle film crossed 100 billion yen worldwide, a first for a Japanese movie
Demon Slayer sold over 220 million manga copies as of July 2025, ranking seventh best‑selling series
The manga concluded in 2020 with roughly 200 chapters, leaving little source material for future expansions
demon_slayer_gets_a_major_future_update_.why_it_matters: The plan highlights how studios aim to turn relatively short shonen hits into enduring franchises, affecting future content strategies.

just_year_after_it_s_surprise_arrival_ne.headline: Teen Wolf (MTV)
just_year_after_it_s_surprise_arrival_ne.summary: All six seasons of MTV’s Teen Wolf will leave Netflix on December 1, 2026.
highlights: The complete run of Teen Wolf is set to be removed from Netflix on December 1, 2026, with the final streaming day being November 30, 2026.
The series returned to Netflix in December 2025 after a decade‑long absence since 2015.
Teen Wolf launched the careers of several future DC actors, including Tyler Hoechlin, Crystal Reed, and Colton Haynes.
The series will no longer be available on Netflix, though the 2023 Teen Wolf: The Movie remains on YouTube.
just_year_after_it_s_surprise_arrival_ne.why_it_matters: Fans will lose access to the full series on a major streaming platform just weeks after its surprise return.

webtoon_ceo_junkoo_kim_receives_outstand.headline: WEBTOON CEO Junkoo Kim Receives Outstanding Contribution Award at Korea's 26th Cartoon Day Ceremony
webtoon_ceo_junkoo_kim_receives_outstand.summary: WEBTOON Entertainment CEO Junkoo Kim was honored with an outstanding contribution award for his role in advancing the webtoon industry at the 26th Cartoon Day ceremony in Bucheon, South Korea.
highlights: The award was presented on November 3, 2026 at the Korea Manhwa Museum.
Kim shared the honor with attorney Sung‑joo Kim for supporting cartoonists' rights.
Twelve major industry groups, including the Korea Cartoonists Association, organized the event.
The ceremony highlighted the global rise of Korean comics and webtoons.
webtoon_ceo_junkoo_kim_receives_outstand.why_it_matters: The recognition underscores the growing international influence of Korean webtoons and the industry's push for creator‑led publishing models.

naruto_manga_return_2026.headline: Witch Watch Season 2
naruto_manga_return_2026.summary: Witch Watch Season 2 is slated to premiere in 2027, with a teaser visual of protagonist Nico Wakatsuki released.
highlights: The second season was announced immediately after the first season’s finale, which aired on October 5, 2025.
A teaser visual featuring Nico Wakatsuki has been unveiled.
The series is streamed on Crunchyroll, where the first season is available.
The manga, created by Kenta Shinohara, has 23 volumes and is licensed in English by Viz Media.
naruto_manga_return_2026.why_it_matters: Fans will get to continue Morihito and Nico’s supernatural adventures with a new season.

odekake_kozame_2nd_film_2026.headline: Criminal
odekake_kozame_2nd_film_2026.summary: Image Comics will re-release two key issues of Ed Brubaker and Sean Phillips’ Criminal as facsimile editions to coincide with the Amazon Prime series debut.
highlights: Facsimile editions of Criminal #1: Coward and Criminal #6: Lawless will launch on January 13 and January 27 respectively

odekake_kozame_2nd_film_2026.why_it_matters: The timed comic reissues give fans a chance to revisit the source material as the TV adaptation reaches a wider audience.

anime_trailer_hana_twin_jan2027.headline: South Park Season 29 Episode "We Be Clubbin'" Focuses on Tweek × Craig
anime_trailer_hana_twin_jan2027.summary: Episode 5 of South Park’s Season 29 gives Tweek and Craig their first dedicated story in nine years.
highlights: The episode "We Be Clubbin'" centers on Tweek and Craig’s relationship, addressing fan demand after a decade without a focus episode.
It marks the first Tweek × Craig centric episode since Season 21’s "Put It Down" in 2017.
The storyline references the 11th anniversary of the original Tweek × Craig episode from Season 19.
Cartman apologizes on‑screen for forgetting the duo’s anniversary, directly responding to online fan complaints.
anime_trailer_hana_twin_jan2027.why_it_matters: It shows South Park’s willingness to engage with long‑standing fan communities by revisiting under‑explored character dynamics.

end_life_preview_dad_s_new_neighbors_hol.headline: End of Life #10
end_life_preview_dad_s_new_neighbors_hol.summary: DC's End of Life #10 arrives in comic shops on November 18, 2026, featuring Eddie driving his dad George to a senior living facility where old Menagerie founders resist his arrival.
highlights: Written by Kyle Starks with art by Steve Pugh and colors by Chris O'Halloran
George’s move to the senior home reveals a clash with fellow Menagerie founders
The issue ships to stores on Wednesday, November 18, 2026
Published by DC Comics under the End of Life series
end_life_preview_dad_s_new_neighbors_hol.why_it_matters: The issue continues the End of Life storyline and introduces a new conflict that expands the series' mythos.

lobo_preview_everyone_shows_up_make_sure.headline: Lobo #9
lobo_preview_everyone_shows_up_make_sure.summary: Lobo #9 from DC Comics hits stores on November 18, 2026 with the story "Burial for a Bastich" following Lobo’s sacrificial death.
highlights: Lobo #9 is scheduled for release on Wednesday, November 18, 2026.
The issue is titled "Burial for a Bastich" and features Lobo’s death after stopping the Blood Garnet Lantern.
Covers are provided by Daniel Warren Johnson, Scott Hepburn, Montos, Skottie Young (A/CA) and Jorge Corona.
The comic is priced at $3.99 with a standard retail price of $4.99 for variant covers.
lobo_preview_everyone_shows_up_make_sure.why_it_matters: The issue marks a major plot development for the anti‑hero Lobo, potentially ending his long‑running storyline in the DCU.

disney_boss_wants_an_avengers_inspired_t.headline: Disney Chief Creative Officer Jared Bush Mulls Avengers-Style Team-Up for Disney Animated Characters
disney_boss_wants_an_avengers_inspired_t.summary: Disney’s chief creative officer Jared Bush said he likes the idea of an Avengers‑style crossover featuring the studio’s iconic animated characters, though no project has been confirmed.
highlights: Bush expressed interest in a team‑up concept during an interview at the SCAD Savannah Film Festival
He clarified he would not claim credit if such a film ever materializes

But one day, Tetsuya comes home to find Tama has grown gigantic! And instead of a peaceful night, Tama takes him on an adventure to defeat the boss of a nearby dungeon! From racing around at high speeds with Tetsuya on his back to granting buffs through purring, it seems that Tama has awakened some extraordinary powers—and Tetsuya decides to livestream this new, exciting life! Meanwhile, Frances Neagley will get her first standalone novel, Zero Margin, in 2027, co-written by Yasmin Angoe and Lee Child. Just shy of 30 years after the first book debuted, the character has never been more popular and is on his way to becoming a genuine cultural institution.

As its official Amazon Prime page shows, the highly anticipated 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray release of AD Police Files is coming much sooner than fans expected. Bubblegum Crisis' First Spinoff Returns in 4K With January Release Date
Animated by Artmic and AIC, AD Police Files premiered in 1990 as the first spinoff of the hit Bubblegum Crisis anime series. The three-part prequel takes place five years before the events of Bubblegum Crisis and largely follows the early days of Advanced Police inspector Leon McNichol's career.
AD Police Files picks up with McNichol in the midst of a battle against a raging Boomer, the franchise's humanoid androids. publication_fingerprints.headline: Arc System Works Opens New Studio Takumi
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Arc System Works Opens New Studio Takumi Arc System Works announced on Thursday it will open Arc System Works Tokyo Studio "Takumi," its new development studio, on November 2. The company stated that it has decided to open a new studio to dramatically strengthen development capabilities across the company, beginning with a new fighting game that has been selected for the "IP360" subsidy project of Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI).
The company added that the new studio is a "strategic cornerstone for going beyond existing conventional game development frameworks and delivering an overwhelming sense of 'ultimate excitement' to players around the world." Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
posted on  by Rafael Antonio Pineda
Visual Arts/Key announced on Monday that writer and composer Jun Maeda (Kanon, Air, Clannad, Angel Beats!) has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer, and has chosen to focus on palliative care, after considering his condition and the outlook for possible treatment.
The announcement also included an e-mail and mailing address for fans to send Maeda a message or letter of encouragement. The staff will accept letters only, and asked fans to refrain from sending gifts or other get-well items. The staff added Maeda is currently hospitalized, but "remains strongly determined to devote himself to creative work through to the very end."
The announcement stated that Maeda has finished work for the first six chapters of the Heaven Burns Red game, including all the major story elements that will take the story to the end of the sixth chapter. He has also completed the lyrics and composition for the songs in the first half of the sixth chapter. Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: U.S. Concerts May Be Canceled The staff for Cygames' Uma Musume Pretty Derbyfranchise announced on Sunday that they have received notice that the U.S. visas needed for the upcoming Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage global tour, scheduled for October 22-23, have yet to be approved.
The staff stated they have been working with lawyers and promoters in the U.S. to secure the necessary visas for over six months. Staff added they are "coordinating with all parties concerned to explore every possible option to get the visas approved and make the concerts happen."
The staff will announce the final decision — whether it is possible to hold the concerts or not — by Monday, October 19 at 10:00 p.m. PDT (Tuesday, October 20 at 1:00 a.m. EDT).
The staff apologized for the concern and inconvenience, and for giving the announcement close to the event date.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Yona of the Dawn Anime Sequel A red-haired princess loses her family and her kingdom… Now she must rise and fight for her throne!
Princess Yona lives an ideal life as the only princess of her kingdom. Doted on by her father, the king, and protected by her faithful guard Hak, she cherishes the time spent with the man she loves, Su-won. But everything changes on her 16th birthday when tragedy strikes her family!
Yona reels from the shock of witnessing a loved one's murder and having to fight for her life. With Hak's help, she flees the palace and struggles to survive while evading her enemy's forces. But where will this displaced princess go when all the paths before her are uncertain?
Kusanagi — the creator of Mugen Spiral, Game X Rush, and NG Life — launched the Yona of the Dawn manga in Hakusensha's Hana to Yume magazine in 2009. The manga ended serialization on December 19. The manga had a four-chapter "gaiden" spinoff that ended in Hana to Yume on July 3. The manga's 48th and final compiled book volume shipped on Tuesday. Viz Media released the 46th volume on July 3.
The first Yona of the Dawn television anime by Pierrot premiered in 2014 and aired for 24 episodes. The manga also inspired three original anim Pierrot Films announced it will animate the planned sequel to the Yona of the Dawn television anime. The official X account confirmed Pierrot Films will handle animation

posted on 2026-10-20 18:00 EDT by Joanna Cayanan
Manga also gets side story in Ultra Jump magazine on December 18

Nakamura's official X (formerly Twitter) account also posted about the manga ending, and added that it will have a side story and a major announcement in the next issue of Ultra Jump on December 18.
Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English digitally and in print. The company describes the story:
Hino Miharu will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job. All he wants is good employment, but when he meets a Santa Claus dressed in clothes as black as coal, he has no idea he's encountered the real deal...sort of. The Santa Claus dressed in red makes Christmas happen for Hikaru Nakamura's Black Night Parade manga concludes with its 12th volume releasing on December 17, 2026. Grotesqqque Anime Film Previews Song by Junna, yutori's Kotoko Satō
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
The official website for Atsushi Nishigori's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "ZUKIZUKI" as performed by JUNNA and the yutori rock band's vocalist Kotoko Satō, two music contributors for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" short story. Yuyoyuppe, another music contributor for "Yoroshiku★Girl," wrote the lyrics as well as scored and arranged the music. The song is now available on various music services, and the website also started streaming the song's collaboration music video with the film:

Eleceed TV Anime's English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals April 2027 Delay
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
The official website for the television anime of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA's webtoon series ELECEED started streaming the anime's English-subtitled trailer, and announced its April 2027 premiere on Wednesday.
Amuse Creative Studio had originally announced a 2026 premiere for the anime.
The anime's YouTube channel describes the story:
Hidden in the shadows of the modern world, there exist associations and organizations of people known as the “Awakened” — those who possess superhuman abilities.
High schooler Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of this world, living in fear while hiding his own mysterious power.
Then one day, after he nurses an injured stray cat back to health, Jiwoo's world is turned upside down.
"Let go of me already, you fool!!"
The battered stray cat — which should never have been able to talk — suddenly speaks?!
The stray cat turns out to be Kayden, the strongest of the Awakened, transformed by mysterious means.
Unable to return to his human form, Kayden begins living with Jiwoo...

publication_fingerprints.headline: Alien (new film)
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Alien (new film) News came earlier this month that Fox was moving forward with a new Alien movie, as one writer spilled the beans about his own involvement. What was unclear at the time, though, was what the next steps for the franchise might be. After the blockbuster success of Alien: Romulus, which became the second highest-grossing movie […] A new Alien movie is in early development, focusing on the android David from the prequel series rather than being a sequel to Alien: Romulus. The project is being written by Aaron Guzikowski, who previously worked with Ridley Scott on the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves. The film will tie into the 2010 prequel sequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant, using David as the connective element. Michael Fassbender is not formally attached and no director has been announced, indicating the film is still in its early stages.

The Rocketeer Trust has filed notice to reclaim The Rocketeer from Disney, according to Boardwalk Times. The trust, represented by Jennifer Bawcum, sister of the late Dave Stevens, creator of the character, is invoking a clause in federal […] The Rocketeer Trust has filed a notice to reclaim the rights to The Rocketeer from Disney, with termination set for June 12, 2028. The Rocketeer Trust, represented by creator Dave Stevens' sister, filed the termination notice on June 11, 2026 Disney will retain distribution rights to existing productions but cannot produce new sequels or reboots without a new agreement after June 12, 2028 Previous revival attempts, including a 2019 Disney Junior series and stalled live‑action projects, have failed to secure Disney’s continued control  June 12, 2028

The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con
The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con... from those who made it back at least
On the way to MCM London Comic Con with a heavy head… because last night ReedPOP had an "Industry Mixer" open bar at the Waterfront on the side of London ExCel. And British comic conventions haven't had an open bar for a long time, and the word started to spread amongst comic creators, retailers, publishers and the like, with representatives from DC, Image, Dark Horse, Forbidden Planet, Diamond UK making their way around the building, following the Thames towards the sound of clinking glasses. It's partially David Baillie's fault, who put the word out as he arrived to find himself the only comics person there, and also to be a bit for shouting out at the Diamond UK Retailer meeting held in the Capital Suites of the ExCel that there was an open bar… and here's the TikTok proof.

One Piece Anime Catalog Fully Available on Crunchyroll India Over 27 years after the anime adaptation officially started airing, the entire One Piece catalog is finally available to stream legally in India, marking a major international expansion.
Crunchyroll is now streaming all 1,180 episodes of the One Piece anime in India, per ANN. The platform added the missing batch from Episodes 326 through 891 on Oct. 25, 2026, covering multiple arcs including the Thriller Bark, Marineford, Fish-Man Island, Dressrosa and Whole Cake Island arcs. With this addition, viewers in India have access to the complete One Piece television anime for the first time since it originally aired in Japan.
Crunchyroll Adds Entire One Piece Anime for the First Time in India
Crunchyroll debuted the One Piece anime in India in September 2023 with the Wano Country arc, adding a total of 186 episodes from 892 through 1077. The episodes were available initially in Japanese with English subtitles, with the English dub sequentially rolling out later that year. The anime will air on ABC and TV Asahi's Animazing!!! programming block, which airs late night on Saturday nights at 26:00 (effectively Sunday mornings at 2:00 a.m.), starting on January 9. The show will first air on AT-X on January 9 at 11:00 p.m. The anime will stream on ABEMA half an hour after the ABC and TV Asahi airing.
The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.
The manga debuted on Kodansha's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.

Kadokawa World Manga English Label Launch News
Kadokawa Launches 'Kadokawa World Manga' English Label on its KadoComi Platform
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Kadokawa announced on Friday it has launched the "Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series on its web manga platform KadoComi. The label is available here.
The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences. Kadokawa stated it will add more titles over time to expand the lineup. The company also stated the label is also a publishing platform for "Kadokawa World Manga Atelier," the publisher's initiative "dedicating to discovering and supporting international creators to develop original works."
The launch lineup for the new label includes:

Simon and Kirby's Airborne Battle in Blue Bolt #7, at Auction
The Green Sorceress uses strategies she learns from the unfolding events of WWII to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat in Simon & Kirby's Blue Bolt #7.
Article Summary
- Blue Bolt #7 channels the early WWII crisis into a Simon and Kirby sci-fi clash with striking Golden Age energy.
- The Green Sorceress studies dictatorship tactics on a telescreen and turns blitzkrieg, sabotage, and propaganda against Blue Bolt.
- The Blue Bolt saga in issue #7 captures Joe Simon and Jack Kirby hitting their stride on both story and wartime atmosphere.
- The issue also features wartime tales by Paul Gustavson and Andrew McWhiney, from stolen rail guns to Air Corps bombers.
As with many comics of the early Golden Age, Joe Simon and Jack Kirby's Blue Bolt saga was heavily influenced by the escalating war. In their story in Blue Bolt #7 (December 1940), the Green Sorceress appears to be defeated when she sees Europe's dictators on a telescreen while a captive of Blue Bolt. Cosplayer Enako Sings, Voice-Acts in Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime
posted on 2026-10-31 03:53 EDT by Crystalyn Hodgkins
New promo video previews opening theme
Kadokawa presented the full promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love (Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai) manga on Saturday. The video announces that Enako is both singing the anime's opening theme song "Gō Yoku Koi o Seisu!?" and joining the cast as the nurse Nene Haneshita.
The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on AT-X, Kansai TV, and Tokyo MX. An advanced screening of the first two episodes will be held in Tokyo on December 13.
The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. As two newbies at love, they become a couple (of sorts) as they find out about romance.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Romelia War Chronicle Anime
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Romelia War Chronicle Anime Seven Seaslicensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:
After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam.
With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.
The anime premiered first via streaming in Japan on U-NEXT, Anime Times, and Netflix on October 3 at 9:00 p.m. (8:00 a.m. EDT). The anime then aired on October 5 at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT) on the Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto channels. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year). Daredevil's Batman-Inspired Debut, Silver Streak Comics #6 at Auction
The debut of the Golden Age Daredevil in Silver Streak Comics #6 borrows elements from Batman stories in Detective Comics #38, #33 and #27.
Silver Streak Comics is a rarity among Golden Age titles in that it was launched with a villain as the cover feature. That villain, The Claw, was both an obvious example of war-era propaganda and based on a blatant racial stereotype. Publisher Lev Gleason was so intent on focusing on this wartime enemies theme that The Claw was cover-featured for the first two issues of the title, with the character meeting with Adolf Hitler in issue #2 and offering to team up with him to conquer the world and split it between them. The title's namesake, the dead-then-resurrected superhero flying speedster character Silver Streak, who himself was named after the futuristic race car in which he was killed, didn't show up until issue #3. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The X-Files (Dynamite) Comic Series The X-Files officially returns this January with a new case, and Mulder and Scully take on their biggest mystery yet. A new teaser for the upcoming story promises a shocking alien threat that only gets worse.
Dynamite Entertainment's new X-Files series officially launches with its first issue on December 9; by the time The X-Files #2 drops on January 13, Mulder and Scully's mission of getting the truth out there is about to be a lot more complicated. Dynamite unveiled cover art and a solicit for the second issue, which begins with reports popping up on social media of wild accounts of young people manifesting strange telekinetic powers. Mulder and Scully head out to debunk another urban legend — but they're not the only ones on the case.
The X-Files' Mulder and Scully Return to Tackle New Alien Threats This January
The new X-Files series is written by Joseph Harris (The X-Files: Season 10 from IDW Publishing, Marvel's Bishop: The Last X-Man) and features art by R.D. Brown. In addition to the eerie alien main cover art for The X-Files #2, Dynamite also announced a slew of variant covers by Clayton Crain, Ivan Tao, Charlie Adlard, and more.

Opera Manga Magazine Announces Shift to Digital Publication
posted on 2026-11-02 01:39 EST by Anita Tai
Final print edition shipped on October 30
The editorial department for Akaneshinsha's Opera magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter) the magazine will switch to a digital format following the release of its 100th and final print issue on Friday. The first digital-only issue will launch in spring 2027.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman Deadline reports Ben Wang (Karate Kid: Legends, American Born Chinese) is in talks to play Bobby Drake/Iceman in the MCU’s X-Men reboot. Wang, 29, purportedly beat out Gabriel LaBelle (The Fabelmans), Jackson Kelly (The Body), and Rhenzy Feliz (The Penguin) for the part of the X-Men’s frosty longtime member in the film, which is being directed by Jake Schreier (Thunderbolts*) for a release in 2028.
Wang, who is a Chinese-born American, would become the second actor to play Iceman on film, following Shawn Ashmore (who portrayed him in the 2000-06 trilogy, and 2014’s Days of Future Past), and the first Asian version of the character. At the time of writing, the only other person of color who’s been cast in the film is Maya Boyd, who will play Ororo Munroe/Storm.
Since Ashmore played the part, the character of Iceman was revealed to be gay in the comics. Whether this will be the case in the movie remains to be seen, but it would add some further diversity to its onscreen cast; however, it should be noted that Kit Connor and Inde Navarrete, who are respectively playing Scott Summers/Cyclops and Anna Marie/Rogue, are both bisexual.

publication_fingerprints.headline: ThunderCats: Lynxana
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
ThunderCats: Lynxana Dynamite has revealed blind bagged copies of the ThunderCats relaunch will include a new comic this week: ThunderCats: Lynxana, a one-shot by writer Nate Cosby (Cheetara: Worldbreaker) and artist Sebastián Píriz (Johnny Quest), starring Lynxana the bounty hunter. Lynxana never appeared on the original TV show, but was introduced in the fourth issue of the Marvel Comics series (created by David Michelinie, Jim Mooney, and Brett Breeding) in 1986.
Cosby outlined the premise, saying, “We snuck a western into the ThunderCats universe. A distress call gets sent out from a shady planet that’s home to the roughest bounty hunters in all the galaxy. Bluegrass (of SilverHawks) goes to answer the call, but gets shot down before he can even begin to investigate. What, and WHO, he finds on that planet, is gonna impact the ThunderCats comics franchise for years to come.”
The comic will set up a follow-up arriving in February 2027, that will in turn lead to Lynxana “crash[ing]” into the main series by Greg Pak and David Cousens, and the Cheetara comic by Saladin Ahmed and Andrea Arcari. Copies will feature further variations of the cover by Píriz, including printings in black-and-white, without t Dynamite will include the new one-shot ThunderCats: Lynxana in blind‑bag copies of its ThunderCats relaunch this week. One‑shot written by Nate Cosby and illustrated by Sebastián

Watari Sakou's Honey Trap Method The 121st issue of Kodansha's Ane Friend magazine revealed on Sunday that Watari Sakou's Honeytra Method (Honey Trap Method) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on December 1. The manga's second and final compiled book volume will debut digitally on January 20.
The manga centers on Uta Manman, the only daughter of a family of spies, who would do anything to win the family succession, even if it means throwing away her virginity. Though still learning to conquer her weakness of doing honey traps, she meets a certain man.
Sakou launched the manga on the Palcy service on March 15, and in the 114th issue of Ane Friend on April 1. Kodansha released the manga's first volume digitally on September 20.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Marvel’s Blade
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Marvel’s Blade Image Courtesy of Xbox Game Studios Developer Arkane Studios’ Lyon location may actually be spared from Microsoft’s draconian and ongoing cuts across multiple departments. Back in July, the electronics giant announced it was going to divest from the studio behind the Dishonored games, potentially laying off hundreds in the process and killing Marvel’s Blade. Spirit Circle TV Anime Adaptation Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for December 2026. A teaser visual and first promotional video were revealed alongside the announcement.
The anime will run for 18 episodes and follows Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old boy who can see ghosts, and transfer student Kouko Ishigami. After Kouko notices the strange mark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she reveals that the two are connected through multiple past lives and begins targeting him over a grudge carried across reincarnations.
The announced cast includes:
- Kazuki Ura as Fuuta Okeya
- Anna Nagase as Kouko Ishigami
- Eri Yukimura as Rune
- Yuichi Nakamura as East
Anna Nagase also performs the ending theme, “Koko ga Donna Sekai demo,” marking her first solo vocal performance.
Tatsuo Sato serves as director and series composer, with Kentaro Mizuno as assistant director and Satoru Fujimoto handling character design. NAGOMI and EOTA are co-producing the animation, with TWIN ENGINE producing the series.
Sato, known for works including Martian Successor Nadesico, Bodacious Space Pirates, and Stellvia, passed away in April 2026. As such, fans are expecting that Trigun Manuscript will revisit many of the events of Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargazer, albeit with new insight and potentially entirely new sequences that were absent from both its predecessors.

G.I. Joe (untitled) Paramount is bringing the G.I. Joe franchise back to theaters with a new live-action movie. The upcoming project will feature Bradley Cooper in a leading role, with Danny McBride directing. The film will introduce a fresh take on the long-running Hasbro property, which has struggled to maintain its theatrical success despite its popularity across toys, comics, and animated shows.
The studio has announced that the untitled movie will hit theaters on October 20, 2028. Cooper will portray Duke, a popular member of the G.I. Joe team. McBride is directing and co-writing the screenplay alongside Jeff Fradley and John Carcieri. Lorenzo di Bonaventura, Mark Vahradian, and Zev Foreman are producing the project.
The upcoming installment will offer a fresh take on the franchise instead of continuing the previously discussed G.I. Joe and Transformers crossover. Although the studio has not disclosed the official plot, McBride reportedly revealed on the Happy Sad Confused podcast that it will be centered on Duke and other members of the team. They will be investigating Springfield, a town secretly controlled by Cobra. 'There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her' Anime Gets 2nd Season
posted on 2026-11-07 03:46 EST by Egan Loo
Main cast to reprise roles
The staff for the television anime of Suisei's There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her (Yūsha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Itanode, Kokuhaku Shite Mita) light novel series and Kairi's manga adaptation announced on Saturday that production on a second season has been green-lit. The main cast will reprise their roles in the new season.
The story centers on Yōki, a man reincarnated into a fantasy world. Yōki did not reincarnate as a hero or the demon lord, however, but as the demon lord's underling. When a hero's party attacks the demon lord's castle, Yōki is naturally there to fight against the heroes. However, when he sees the priest Cecilia who is part of the hero's party, he falls in love at first sight.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret The official website for the television anime of Kashiko Amane's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret (Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru) manga presented a new teaser promotional video on Saturday. The video announces three more cast members from the idol group ≒JOY, and it also announces and previews the ending theme song "Naritai Watashi" (The Me I Want To Become) by the in-story idol group Indigo Impulse.
Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!
The anime will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.
Amane has been serializing the manga on Hakusensha's Young Animal Web site since September 2022, and Hakusensha published the ninth volume this past July. Sins of Kujo After a debut on Netflix, ABC’s hit crime drama is finally coming back. Season 5 of Will Trent will be premiering in a matter of months.
ABC has released its midseason 2027 schedule, and via The Hollywood Reporter, it reveals that Will Trent is set to return on Tuesday, Jan. 5. Will Trent has been on hiatus since May, and like The Rookie, has been airing exclusively during midseason for the last couple of years. That format is continuing for Season 5, but the wait will surely be worth it.
Will Trent Continues to Be a Hit for ABC
Premiering in 2023, Will Trent was created by Liz Heldens and Daniel Thomsen. It’s based on the series of novels by Karin Slaughter. Ramón Rodriguez stars as the titular Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) Special Agent, who was abandoned at birth and “endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta’s overwhelmed foster care system. Now, Will uses his unique point of view in the pursuit of justice and has the highest clearance rate in the GBI.”
Along with Rodriguez, Will Trent stars Erika Christensen, Iantha Richardson, Jake McLaughlin, Kevin Daniels, and Alexandra Metz. The Rookie The Rookie may have been absent from the fall 2026 schedule, but the franchise is about to make a big comeback. The Mothership and its latest spinoff are officially returning to ABC in three months.
According to The Hollywood Reporter, the Disney-owned network has confirmed that both The Rookie and The Rookie: North will premiere on Wednesday, Jan. 6. The Rookie's return date was previously announced at New York Comic Con, along with the spinoff, but ABC has now unveiled its full midseason schedule.
The Rookie Season 9 will kick off the two-hour block at 8 p.m. ET, followed by The Rookie: North at 10 p.m. ET. Shifting Gears will join the procedurals for Season 3 on Jan. 6, with Abbott Elementary rejoining the lineup the following week to continue Season 6.
What Happened in The Rookie Season 8?
When The Rookie premieres its ninth season in January, the series will be picking up from a major cliffhanger. The end of the Season 8 finale in May saw fan-favorite couple Tim Bradford (Eric Winter) and Lucy Chen (Melissa O’Neil) finally getting engaged. Abema Selects Project PRISMation's 1st Open Call Finalists to Make 3 Pilot Anime
posted on  by Egan Loo
The Japanese streaming service ABEMA announced the three finalists from the first open call in its "Project PRISMation" for independent animators on Friday. The three selected entries will each receive production funding for a short original anime pilot slated for next year or later.
The three selected entries are:
"OXY-HEAVEN"

A fantasy ensemble drama set in a steampunk world.

Gacha Girls Corps Gacha Girls Corps anime announced a January 7, 2027 premiere date. A main visual and two additional cast members were also released. Joining the cast are Aimi Ozawa as Migle and Renon Esumi as Lennon.
A trailer was previously released. Takashi Asami is directing the anime at studios Zero-G and Saber Works. Deko Akao is in charge of series composition, while Minewo Suzuki is in charge of character designs. Hiroaki Tsutsumi and George King are composing the music. The cast includes:
- Daisuke Sakaguchi as Heihachi Okura
- Miyu Tomita as Norl Fanya
- Iori Noguchi as Estelle
Gacha Girls Corps is a light novel series written by Chinkururi with illustrations provided by Yasutaka Isekawa. It was originally launched as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in January 2016. Micro Magazine then published nine volumes in print under their GC Novels imprint from November 2016 to August 2020.
Syuu Haruno illustrated the manga adaptation, which began its serialization in Micro Magazine’s Comic Ride online magazine in March 2018. Kaiten Books is licensing the manga in English and they describe it as:

publication_fingerprints.headline: Harajuku Himegoto House
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Harajuku Himegoto House The "high-tempo gag" story follows an aspiring hitman who heads to a rumored hideout for assassins in Harajuku, only to discover a cafe staffed by an eclectic group of high-fashion, eccentric individuals.
The project's cast includes:
Yūya Hirose as Mizuki Otokozawa, an aspiring hitman
Tetsuei Sumiya as Mero Togariishi, a high-tension positive "gal"
Sōhei Horikane as Takara Rokurokusō, a foul-mouthed gothic lolita doll
Masaru Yoshimura as Kentarō Jinbayama, a centaur who is the ideal man
Takuma Nagatsuka as Yuki Inubo, a man who wants cure his blue mood
Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hitoshi Haritsukekawara; the twin-tailed, 50-year-old, decora-fashionista store manager
Showtaro Morikubo as Shō Dogenzaka, a flashy men who is 2 trillion yen (about US$12.6 billion) in debt
Plott is responsible for the project's planning and production, Bandai Namco Music Live (Lantis) is providing the project's music, and Animate is collaborating on promotion. Visual artist Aki Akane (also known as Akane Aki) drafted the project's original character illustrations.
The project's first group song will debut on Sunday.

When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated...?
Aoi (Gamers! light novel series) and Tsuzura debuted the manga in Hakusensha's Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on August 28.
Aoi and Sabotenn launched the Gamers! novel series in 2014. Tsubasa Takahashi launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in October 2016. The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in July 2017. Crunchyrollstreamed the anime as it aired in Japan. Funimationstreamed an English dub and released the series on home video.

Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc (live-action series) The official website for Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc), the new live-action series based on Satoru Noda's Golden Kamuy manga, unveiled two more cast members as well as a new key visual for the series on Monday.
The live-action series will debut streaming on WOWOW on January 24.
The first live-action Golden Kamuy film opened in Japan in January 2024 and topped the Japanese box office in its first weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets for 533,848,690 yen (about US$3.44 million in current conversion) in its first three days. Netflix began streaming the first film in May 2024.
Shigeaki Kubo directed the first film at production company CREDEUS. Tsutomu Kuroiwa wrote the script. Yutaka Yamada composed the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe were credited as Ainu culture advisers.
Kenji Katagiri, Ken Ochiai, and Yōsuke Satō joined the film's director Kubo on directing the follow-up Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- live-action series. Similarly, Yoshiaki Dewa joined the film's composer Yamada for the series. Japanese rock group ACIDMAN performed the theme song "Kagayakerumono" (Those Who Shine). publication_fingerprints.headline: Hinemosu Notari Nikki
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Hinemosu Notari Nikki Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine confirmed on Friday that the eighth compiled book volume of the lateTetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will be the final volume when it ships on February 12. Shogakukan will also publish Gagyō 70-shūnen Ai to Heiwa to Chiba Tetsuya (70th Anniversary as an Working Artist: Love, Peace, and Tetsuya Chiba), a commemorative book tracing Chiba's 70 years as a manga artist, on February 12.
Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health. Chiba died on October 22 due to a myelodysplastic syndrome, a type of cancer that affects the blood cells in the bone marrow.
Chiba debuted as a professional manga creator when he was still in high school at 17 years old in 1956. He is perhaps best known for his Ashita no Joe (Tomorrow's Joe) boxing manga, which ran from 1968 to 1973, and has remained a mainstay in Japanese popular culture for decades. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.

GAMERA -Rebirth Most long-running anime often wind up with at least one botched episode that can crash the entire momentum of the season, or the entire series. Thankfully, plenty of single-season anime sidestep this particular issue by bringing something meaningful with every episode. Some of the best single-season anime have no awkward episodes or quality drops that feel jarring.
The best part about single-season anime is their compact yet satisfying storylines. From psychological horror to moving romances and even intense sports, some anime have proven that they don’t need multiple seasons to leave an impact on their viewers.

Harley Quinn #71 Harley Quinn’s about to make a big move. DC has announced that the ongoing Harley Quinn series is getting a new creative team, and a new settings. Writer Joanne Starer and artists Lukas Ketner and Dave McCaig will take over the series with February’s issue #71, which will set the stage for Harley to move from New York to Paris in the ensuing months.
Here’s how DC describes the forthcoming new direction for Harley’s ongoing adventures:
Starer and Ketner are taking Harley from Brooklyn to France in a new story that finds her living with two terrible roommates, traveling abroad with a forged Justice League ID, assembling an unlikely crew of super-powered individuals, and attempting the most Harley Quinn-esque caper imaginable: stealing the Mona Lisa from the Louvre. And as if that isn’t enough trouble, an international cadre of assassins is after Harley’s head.
Before Harley can take Paris, however, Harley Quinn #71 has some unfinished business closer to home, including haunting childhood memories, an adult bat mitzvah, and one very important question: If you invite Batman to a bat mitzvah, does he have to show up?

Tekken 8 Game Streams Roger Jr. Starter Guide
posted on 2026-11-10 19:00 EST by Anita Tai
Season 3 character launches in early access on November 11
Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming a starter guide video for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3, on Tuesday ahead of the character's early access release on Wednesday.
The character will be available for early access on November 11, and will launch officially on November 16.
Other Season 3 characters include Kunimitsu, Bob, and Yūjirō Hanma, the father of protagonist Baki Hanma from the Baki manga and anime series. Kunimitsu launched on June 2 in Japan and June 1 in the United States. The character launched on Early Access on May 28 in Japan and May 27 in the U.S. Bob was released for early access on August 19, and was officially released on August 24. Yūjirō Hanma will debut in early 2027.
Season 2 added Anna Williams in March 2025, Fahkumram in July 2025, Armor King in October 2025, and Miary Zo in Roger Jr. Roger Jr. early access begins on November 11, 2026 for Season 3 Character Pass holders Full release for all players follows on November 16, 2026 Season

publication_fingerprints.headline: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
SSS-Class Revival Hunter A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gongja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.
The anime stars:
Takeo Ōtsuka as Gongja Kim (listed as Yeon-ja Kim on the anime's website)
The anime will debut in January on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block. Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide, excluding Asia, with availability in the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia.
The original novel debuted in November 2018, and the webtoon launched in December 2020. Tapas publishes the webtoon in English digitally, and Ize Press is releasing the series in print. WuxiaWorldpublishes the web novel in English.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box The anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya’s Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box has been officially announced for 2027. A teaser visual, teaser trailer, and the main staff were revealed alongside the announcement.
The main staff includes:
- Director: Chiaki Kon
- Series Composition: Seishi Minakami
- Character Design: Mai Furuki
- Animation Production: J.C.STAFF
Kon previously directed Nodame Cantabile: Paris Arc and Nodame Cantabile Finale, while J.C.STAFF also produced the Nodame Cantabile anime adaptations.
Director Chiaki Kon commented:
I’m grateful to have the opportunity to be involved in Tomoko Ninomiya-sensei’s work once again.
The stories that unfold from gemstones are truly fascinating.
I’m going to enjoy bringing these gemstone stories to life beautifully in anime for you all, so I hope you will do your best at watching. 
Tomoko Ninomiya is also the creator of Nodame Cantabile, which received the 2004 Kodansha Manga Award for shojo manga. You can see the creator’s commemorative illustration for the new anime announcement below.

They revealed that screenwriter Chiaki Morosawa and Shigeru Morita wrote the prequel's scenario while planning for Gundam Seed Freedom itself. Behind the Mask II: The Return of Leslie Vernon A Nightmare on Elm Street star and revered horror legend Robert Englund is coming back to another franchise. The actor is returning for a sequel to his cult classic meta-slasher film, Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon, with production officially underway.
According to an update on the project shared on Instagram by actor Ben Pace, production has started in Illinois on Behind the Mask II: The Return of Leslie Vernon. Its production is starting two decades after the first installment was released in 2006. The sequel rolling its cameras comes after a crowdfunding campaign was launched to help fund the new movie, when it was announced that Englund was among the returning stars also coming back.
Robert Englund Returns in the Leslie Vernon Sequel
In the 2006 film, Robert Englund played Doc Halloran. The character had a limited presence in the original, but is expected to be a more substantial part of the sequel. Nathan Baesel also returns as the titular Leslie Vernon, while Angela Goethals reprises her role as Taylor Gentry. Scott Glasserman is back in the director's chair, while writer David J.
