Children of Blood and Bone The next epic fantasy film trilogy is making its presence known. On Thursday, Paramount released a new trailer for Children of Blood and Bone.
Children of Blood and Bone is a movie based on the hit 2018 YA fantasy novel by Tomi Adeyemi. That book spawned two sequels -- Children of Virtue and Vengeance and Children of Anguish and Anarchy.
Children of Blood and Bone Gets New Trailer
Children of Blood and Bone introduces audiences to the epic fantasy world of Orïsha. In the story, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.
The Children of Blood and Bone book's synopsis goes into more dramatic detail: "Zélie Adebola remembers when the soil of Orïsha hummed with magic. Burners ignited flames, Tiders beckoned waves, and Zélie’s Reaper mother summoned forth souls. But everything changed the night magic disappeared. Under the orders of a ruthless king, maji were killed, leaving Zélie without a mother and her people without hope.

Lulumiru BL Webtoon Platform Kakao Piccoma, the Japanese subsidiary of Kakao, announced on November 5 it has launched a new webtoon platform titled Lulumiru. The webtoon platform focuses only on boys-love content, and is currently inaccessible outside of Japan.
The service is available on web browsers on smartphones, tablets, and PCs. Membership is free and readers can purchase works chapter by chapter. Lulumiru hosts both new series and older series that have had lasting popularity.
The service also has a search function that lets users omit certain characteristics and tags that they do not like, and also a "top x bottom" search function that allows users to choose certain characteristics they want to see in each member of a romantic pairing.
Kakao Piccoma is hosting large-scale advertisements for the new service in Ikebukuro in Tokyo from November 9 through November 22.
Kakao Piccoma currently operates the Piccoma service in Japan, which offers webtoons, web manga, and web novels.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Furious Redbrow
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Furious Redbrow Dark Horse Comics has announced Furious Redbrow, a new three-issue fantasy series by Ben Stenbeck, set in Stenbeck and Mike Mignola‘s Lands Unknown universe. Building on Stenbeck’s 2026 series The Skinless Man, the comic will introduce readers to the barbarian Redbrow, who’ll become known in the years to come as the God-Killer.
The official synopsis reminds readers that in the prior series, “a mysterious old Warrior and his animal companions hear[d] a chilling tale from a witch. But who was this man, the one the witch called God-Killer? Where did he come from and what was it that he sought? Now the God-Killer takes center stage as Furious Redbrow finally reveals Redbrow, son of Whitedog, blessed by the spider woman, and raised to kill all monsters.”
“I introduced the weathered old man Redbrow in The Skinless Man,” says Stenbeck. “Now, I’m going back to his youth and the world he grew up in far off to the west of Lands Unknown. A savage unforgiving place to live, for man or beast.” The book will also feature colors and lettering by respective stalwart Mignola collaborators Dave Stewart and Clem Robins.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Superman ’78
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Superman ’78 Image Courtesy of DC Comics Hollywood has a long history of adapting comic books into movies with the Marvel Cinematic Universe being the best example. Similarly, movies are often adapted into comics and frequently when a hit movie is released, the comic book industry tries to capitalize on its success with sequel comics. Some of these comic spin-offs of film […] DC Comics released a sequel miniseries to the 1978 Superman film, continuing its story with Brainiac and Metallo. The miniseries follows the film’s continuity, featuring Brainiac shrinking Metropolis and capturing Kryptonian citizens including Jor-El A follow‑up story, The Metal Curtain, pits Superman against a Soviet‑styled Metallo with a Kryptonite‑powered suit The comics aim to capture the light‑hearted tone of the original movie, free from its special‑effects limitations Print

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Gonbe Shinkawa's Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku (Uzono Shiniko Report) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 7.
The manga is about the informal investigation carried out by the Japanese government, the military, investigative agencies, and ordinary citizens since 1892, about the strange phenomena called "Uzono Shiniko." It is said that if a human, animal, or any inanimate object's name is changed to "Uzono Shiniko," it suddenly attracts disaster.
Shinkawa launched the series on Kadokawa's ComicWalker manga website in December 2024. The manga is an adaptation of Bunkichi Majima's novel of the same title. Asahiro Kakashi is credited for the manga's storyboard composition.
Disclosure: Kadokawa World Entertainment (KWE), a wholly owned subsidiary of Kadokawa Corporation, is the majority owner of Anime News Network, LLC. One or more of the companies mentioned in this article are part of the Kadokawa Group of Companies.

The Batman (Part II) Sterling Ulrich is a Senior Staff Writer for CBR. He was a summa cum laude graduate of Aquinas College with a Bachelor of Arts in English with a Literature Emphasis and a minor in History. He has in-depth academic and pop-cultural knowledge of J. R. R. Tolkien's legendarium.
Matt Reeves' 2022 film The Batman was one of the most beloved DC projects of the past decade. It became the third-highest-grossing Batman film of all time, and it was praised by critics and general audiences alike. Though many were initially skeptical that former Twilight star Robert Pattinson could effectively portray the Caped Crusader, he gave a strong performance that won over most naysayers.
The Batman Part II entered development in 2022, but the sequel has been slow to gestate, and it is not scheduled to be released until early 2028. Though Pattinson has expressed a desire to continue playing Batman for as long as he is able, a recent development has called his future as the Dark Knight into question. Amazon MGM Studios recently announced that Pattinson will be the next James Bond, and he will likely need to hang up the cape and cowl to facilitate his new role.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Grendel
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Grendel Though it may seem inconceivable, Matt Wagner’s acclaimed character and series Grendel has yet to be adapted for film or television. More than forty years after the character’s debut in comics, it was officially announced that Netflix has ordered a Grendel animated series with Bobak Esfarjani (Widow’s Bay, WandaVision, Alien: Earth) involved as writer, executive producer and showrunner
First debuting in 1982 in the pages of Comico Primer #2, the character quickly gained his own title. Following the bankruptcy of original publisher Comico, the characters and series languished in limbo for some time before finding a new publishing home at Dark Horse Comics and has remained there ever since.
A quick primer for those unfamiliar with the series:
After the woman he loves is shockingly murdered, Hunter Rose devotes himself to one thing: vengeance. But as he tears through street gangs, the elite, and New York City’s supernatural underworld in pursuit of her killer, a chance at a real life forces him to choose: walk away from ultimate power, or become the very monster he hunts.
In addition Esfarjani, other executive producers for the Grendel animated series include Chris Tongue, Tim Wiesch Netflix has officially ordered an animated series adaptation of Matt Wagner’s comic Grendel. AI platform MangaNow Studio is directing, producing, and editing the comic anime.

Aoki and Ayamine debuted the manga in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 1999, and ended it in February 2007. The manga had 39 compiled book volumes. Tokyopop once published the manga before losing the rights in 2009.

The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Finale Ahead of the finale of the current third season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, it's been announced that the episode has gotten a bump in its release date. Now, fans will be able to watch it sooner than expected.
On X, it was announced by Prime video that the Season 3 finale would be arriving a day early on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at 6 p.m. PT (9 p.m. ET). Episodes of the series are regularly released on Wednesdays, and the finale was originally scheduled for a Nov. 25 debut. Giving the episode an earlier drop will also allow fans to watch it before the busy Thanksgiving holiday period, when many will be preoccupied with travel and family functions.
The Rings of Power Season 3 Finale Drops a Day Early
The third season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power premiered on Nov. 11, over two years after Season 2's 2024 debut. Season 3 introduced a different release strategy, starting off with the simultaneous launch of the first four episodes. Two more debuted on Nov. 18, while the final two will premiere on Nov. 24. The first two seasons had each debuted with multiple episodes before then having one episode release weekly after that.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiruran Manga Gets New Stage Play by All-Female Troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiruran Manga Gets New Stage Play by All-Female Troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue The all-female troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue (also known as 096k Kumamoto Revue) announced on Friday that they will produce a new stage play based on Eiji Hashimoto and Shinya Umemura's Chiruran: Shinsengumi Requiem (Chiruran: Shinsengumi Chinkon-ka) manga in early summer 2027.
Original author Umemura is writing the script. Hajime Kikuchi is directing the new play.
The manga inspired a previous stage play adaptation that ran in April 2017.
Titan Mangalicensed the manga for release as 3-in-1 omnibus editions, and it describes the story:
Before he became the legendary Vice Commander of the feared Shinsengumi, Hijikata Toshizou was a reckless young swordsman determined to carve out his place in a nation on the brink of collapse. As political unrest tears Japan apart and violence erupts in the streets of Kyoto, Toshizou and his comrades will forge the Shinsengumi, the ruthless “Mibu Wolves”, a band of warriors sworn to restore order at any cost.
Umemura provided the story, and Hashimoto illustrated the manga. The duo launched the series in the inaugural issue of Tokuma Shoten's Monthly Comic Zenon magazine in 2010. The manga began its final arc with the 32nd compiled book volume in Jan The manga Chiruran will be adapted into a new stage play written by original author Umemura and directed by Hajime Kikuc

publication_fingerprints.headline: Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara The "new type of misunderstanding battle romantic comedy" manga centers on Kotarō Hinode, who when he was young was constantly humiliated in wrestling, basketball, and games by three children named Akira, Kanae, and Shigure, respectively. Now in high school, Kotarō vows to get back at them, and returns to his hometown. However, it turns out Akira, Kanae, and Shigure were not boys like Kotarō thought, but were girls. And now these three girls are young women who look like a gyaru, rich girl, and beautiful girl. In addition, all three start treating him kindly.
Matsumoto launched the manga in March 2023 on the "Suiyōbi no Sirius" platform on Nico Nico Seiga. Kodansha will publish the 10th compiled volume on December 9.

Kindergarten WARS Kindergarten WARS anime has unveiled the main visual and a new trailer on Wednesday. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Bibayatarametta” by Ado. The series debuts in April 2027.
Studio Sunrise and Felix Film are animating the series with Shinsuke Gomi as director. Junko Yamanaka is the character designer. The previously announced voice cast includes:
- Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita
- Kentaro Kumagai as Doug
- Hitomi Owada as Hana
- Satoshi Hino as Luke
- Mariya Ise as Silvia
- Romi Park as Erina
- Tetsu Inada as Gordon
- Mirei Kumagai as Mac
- Sumire Morohoshi as Una
You Chiba writes and draws the Kindergarten WARS manga, which began serialization on Shueisha’s Shonen Jump+ app and website in September 2022. It has released 15 volumes as of August 2025. Yen Press is releasing the manga in English, describing the story:
Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she’s head-over-heels for good-looking men!
Source: Kindergarten Wars Official X

The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess News
The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess TV Anime Reveals January 1 Debut in Video
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
The official website for the television anime of writer Kotoko and artist Kaname Hanamiya's The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me (Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Nazeka Last Boss О̄jisama ni Shūchaku Sareteimasu) manga revealed the show's main promotional video on Thursday, alongside the announcement of the show's debut on January 1.
The anime will debut on January 1 at 10:30 p.m. on AT-X. The series will then air on Tokyo MX, BS NTV, and CBC TV on January 8. The series will stream on services such as d Anime Store, ABEMA, and more in Japan starting on January 1 at 25:00 (effectively January 2 at 1:00 a.m.).
Additionally, the website revealed one more cast member, the theme song artists, and the main visual on Thursday.
Yoshitsugu Matsuoka will voice Richard (pictured above with white hair) in the series.
REIRIE performs the opening theme song "Yorore Yoen," and SERRA performs the ending theme song "Silhouette Letter."
The anime stars:
- Haruka Shiraishi as Celine
- Takeo Ōtsuka as Wilfre The TV anime adaptation will debut on January 1, 2027, airing first on AT‑X before expanding to other Japanese channels and stream

publication_fingerprints.headline: I Am Legend (2007) – Director Francis Lawrence Criticizes Film’s Ending
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
I Am Legend (2007) – Director Francis Lawrence Criticizes Film’s Ending I Am Legend director Francis Lawrence has shared his candid thoughts on how the 2007 film ended. Lawrence called the movie’s ending “a bit of failure” in a recent podcast.
Speaking on the Team Deakins podcast, Lawrence revisited the 2007 film and discussed how the creatures turned out on screen. Looking back, he felt they were too similar to humans and believed their design should have been different.
“I’m really proud of the first hour of that movie,” he shared of the I Am Legend film, which focused more on Neville’s story and his survival. “But the last 40 minutes, where the creatures end up becoming a big part of it, I think it’s a bit of a failure, honestly, and we just didn’t approach it the way that we should have and could have.”
Lawrence then revisited the original ending, in which Will Smith’s character fails to find a cure and leaves Anna to the monsters. “That was our original ending. It tested horribly twice. Twice,” the filmmaker revealed. He added that the team shot a replacement ending three months before the film’s release, which eventually became the theatrical ending audiences saw in 2007.
Which ending will I Am Legend 2 stick with?

House of M Avengers: Doomsday marks the return of Joe and Anthony Russo to the MCU. They will also be directing Avengers: Secret Wars, which will bring the Multiverse Saga to an end. Joe Russo has also expressed interest in exploring another major Marvel Comics storyline after Secret Wars.
Speaking with SFX Magazine, he expressed his interest in adapting The House of M storyline in the MCU. He revealed that the story was considered for Doomsday, but a more extensive adaptation could still be explored in the franchise’s future.
The Marvel Cinematic Universe will be pushing into its mutant era following Avengers: Secret Wars. Its 2028 slate includes its first X-Men feature, Black Panther III, and Ghost Rider. House of M may potentially follow a different Scarlet Witch instead of Elizabeth Olsen, considering the younger ages of the MCU’s X-Men.
Joe Russo sees more potential in House of M as the X-Men approach the MCU
Regarding House of M, Joe Russo said, “I mean, they dabbled in it [with Avengers: Doomsday], but there’s certainly a more robust interpretation of House of M [X-Men/Avengers crossover series from 2005] that could be done. Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man A new poster shows Spider-Man‘s battle with Sandman ahead of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Season 2. However, the artwork comes from the second issue of an all-new comic book series set between seasons of the hit Disney+ animated show.
According to an image shared by Spider-Man News on X, the variant cover shows Sandman grabbing Spider-Man’s head as the hero seemingly tries to escape. Moreover, the web-slinger is surrounded by several distorted open-mouthed faces and oversized hands emerging from the villain’s swirling sand.
The official description for the issue reads, “Sand Gets Everywhere! It’s Spidey vs. the Sandman, and Spidey’s in over his head…literally! The sand is above his head. Can he come out on top?!”
The terrifying artwork offers a glimpse of the darker side of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Season 2
The cover emphasizes the more horrifying side of Sandman as the villain enters the animated show’s universe. This also marks a visual shift from Season 1, which drew heavily from the classic 1960s Spider-Man comics, particularly in its animation style.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Maid Cafe Akira Mori
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Maid Cafe Akira Mori The horror genre has a fascinating way of painting the most lighthearted and innocent things in an utterly unsettling light. It is no wonder there are so many people afraid of clowns and dolls following the success of movies like It and Child's Play.
It appears that one of the latest topics to fall prey to nightmarization is Maid Cafés, which are themed restaurants involving female servers dressed in old-fashioned cleaning woman uniforms. The culprit in this case is a recent horror comic book which has a sequel on the way.
Maid Cafe Akai Mori #1 To Slash About In 2027
The concept of the housemaid has taken on many different forms, most notably in risque subject matter or in more action-oriented stories, like anime series featuring cute but deadly maid characters. The makers of the independent horror comic book Maid Cafe have adopted the latter style, but taken things up a notch.
Ex Posse Holdings, in partnership with Keenspot, is furthering the rebranding of maids as the stuff of nightmares by continuing the franchise. Coming in winter 2027 is the series' official follow-up, Maid Cafe Akai Mori, which offers a more Western-style flavor this time.
According to the official synopsis, The horror comic Maid Cafe is returning with a sequel, Maid Cafe Akai Mori, slated for release in winter 2027. Ex Posse Holdings and Keenspot are publishing the follow‑up series

publication_fingerprints.headline: Solo Leveling: Gaiden Volume 2
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Solo Leveling: Gaiden Volume 2 Sung Jinwoo just got a brand-new redesign from the artist behind Solo Leveling’s sequel series.
Solo Leveling: Gaiden, the manga version of the webtoon’s epilogue currently being serialized in Japan, revealed the cover to its second volume on November 27. Releasing on December 23, Solo Leveling: Gaiden Volume 2 continues Jinwoo’s story after he has defeated the Monarchs and reset the world with the Cup of Reincarnation.
The new Jinwoo redesign is a recreation of his pose from Solo Leveling Chapter 192 (Special Episode 11), during Jinwoo’s stint as a police detective in the new timeline.
Sung Jinwoo’s New Design Could Be a Sneak Peek at His Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Art Style
In the specific panel used as a reference for this art, Jinwoo extracts the shadow of a girl whose death he’s investigating at a crime scene. After raising her shadow, Jinwoo learns the terrible truth that led to her untimely death, inspiring Jinwoo to take the law into his own hands to deal divine justice in a way that only someone with his godly powers could.
The art for this scene in the original webtoon was credited to the “Disciples of DUBU,” though it’s at least likely that it could have been drawn by JIN, Solo Leveling: Gaiden Volume 2 will release on December 23 with a new cover redesign of Sung Jinwoo based on Chapter 192.
